The reduced cohomology ring R=F2[t]/Phi_19 is the FIELD F_{2^18}, since ord_19(2)=18, so any nonzero c is a unit. Published Theorem7.1 Massey formula and naturality are trilinear; preservation modulo span of the endpoints must hold for every (k,l)∈Z19². The actual source verify.cpp independently inspected enumerates ALL 32 nonhomeomorphic normalized pairs, both allowed beta for each, every nonzero c (2^18-1), and all 361 ordered input pairs; exact bitmask polynomial ring conditions. Thus a genuine exhaustive FINITE obstruction, not a timeout or empirical approximation, rejects all 32. Earlier p5, p7, p11 and homeomorphic controls in original source additionally inspected.
